topic.title: Integrating High Power M.2 Components into Platform

ul.li: Certain M.2 components (ex: hybrid storage, WWAN module) can pose thermal challenges under certain scenarios

Designing these usage scenarios will require special considerations
Optimize Air flow to M.2 – place close to a fan
Minimize ambient temp by the M.2 – place M.2 away from heat source
Add thermal mechanical - thermal pad and heat spreader, if necessary
Contact your field rep or supplier to understand M.2 component usage guidance
Intel recommends using Intel Dynamic Tuning Technology to manage M.2 component power/perf/thermals
